trap-negation-contrast.evidence: The few denials are technical scope ('without analytic limits', 'no convergence requirement', the falsification path's 'not matching the leading exponent'); no assert-by-denying.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: 'This is a substantive conceptual simplification; whether it corresponds to a practical proof technique ... depends on computability' is a hedge attached to its own claim, not a reframe that shifts the weight to a trailing clause.

trap-em-dash.evidence: 4 em-dashes over 840 words; three append a gloss inside bullet items ('gap closes linearly — generic first-order closure'), which is list convention rather than sentence-structure substitution.

trap-triples.evidence: The 'Contrast with classical spectral theory' section is a mirrored 3-vs-3 list, but each of the six items is a distinct technical requirement or replacement.
trap-triples.notes: Shape note: the parallel 3/3 is rhetorical; the items themselves are substantive.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Closing 'if so, the classical-limit discussions simplify substantially; if not, the surreal lift is a curiosity' states the conjecture's stakes; it is an honest self-assessment carrying content.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The Open problem section adds the conditional-importance assessment rather than restating the conjecture.

trap-superlative.evidence: Opening universal is unqualified and the block later contradicts it: 'every spectral operator O_q of this paper (Hecke generators, transfer matrices, q-Hamiltonians, Feynman integrals, vortex operators) has eigenvalues lambda_i(q) that are rational in epsilon' — but the Proof strategy section carries a 'Transcendental case (speculative)' for 'operators whose entries involve the quantum dilogarithm or other transcendentals', and the conjecture's own item 4 classifies transcendental ord_omega. Secondary: 'This is a substantive conceptual simplification' is an unqualified self-assessment.
trap-superlative.notes: Proposed: scope the opener to the algebraic case — 'every spectral operator of this paper whose matrix entries lie in Q(q) has eigenvalues rational in epsilon; operators built from the quantum dilogarithm are the transcendental case treated below.'
